title: Days in a month
description:
Write `int daysInMonth(int month, bool leapYear)`.

- Months 1 to 12 return the right number of days (February is 28, or 29 in a leap year).
- Anything else returns `-1`.

Read the tests before you start: they list the edge cases a careful programmer would think of. Writing code to pass a list of cases you wrote down first is the heart of test-driven development.
lessonTitle: Halts, goto, and Testing Your Code
